title: Radio Interview Jozi FM
summary: Lesaka's radio interview feature with Jozi FM, part of the Lesaka newsroom.
body_markdown:
### Lesaka brings the power of Fintech to communities across South Africa


###


###


Lesaka officially launched its community roadshow with a vibrant celebration at Bara Taxi Rank, and[Jozi FM](https://www.jozifm.co.za/) was there! The event brought together community members, customers, and local partners to learn more about how Lesaka is making financial services more accessible and empowering South Africans through innovative fintech solutions.


###


###


Lesaka enables individuals and small business owners to pay, receive payments, borrow, insure, and grow their businesses through a range of accessible financial products and services. The roadshow has already sparked meaningful conversations, helping communities better understand the Lesaka brand and the value it brings to their daily lives.


###


###


A special highlight of the event was the participation of the[Field Band Foundation](https://fieldband.org.za/) , a non-profit organisation that uses music and performance to positively impact young people's lives. Through Lesaka's partnership with the Foundation, local bands are helping bring energy, pride, and community spirit to the celebrations.


###


###


The Lesaka roadshow will continue over the next nine months, visiting communities across Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, and beyond. Upcoming stops include Mamelodi and Lenasia, where residents can enjoy community parades, live entertainment, competitions, and opportunities to learn more about Lesaka's services.
